tagline: Leading private mortgage insurance provider enabling homeownership in the U.S. residential market
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI is the primary driver of the business: production of new insurance contracts (NIW) directly reflects demand for residential mortgage credit and market share gained in a cyclical yet structural sector.

kpis.name: New business private mortgage insurance
kpis.explanation: Amount of new insurance contracts underwritten during the year.
kpis.description: NIW is the primary growth indicator for Essent, directly linked to residential loan volumes and interest rates.
kpis.signal: Decline reflecting slowdown in the U.S. real estate market.

kpis.name: Gross profit margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between premiums collected and claims paid, relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Key margin in insurance, reflecting underwriting discipline and portfolio quality.
kpis.signal: Improvement driven by better risk selection.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Core profitability indicator, improving due to scale benefits.
kpis.signal: Sustained increase supported by operating expense control.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Profit after taxes for the year.
kpis.description: Net income reflects the combined impact of underwriting, claims, and expenses.
kpis.signal: Slight decline despite improved margins, linked to NIW contraction.

kpis.name: Total balance sheet
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Assets are primarily invested in high-grade bonds to cover liabilities.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth linked to premium investment.

kpis.name: Return on equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by shareholders' equity.
kpis.description: ROE key metric for shareholders, reflecting efficiency of capital deployment.
kpis.signal: Slight decline despite good discipline, linked to equity base growth.

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.5 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash and equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of 0.12 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Default rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of insured loans in default.
kpis.description: Key indicator of portfolio health, consistently declining since 2021.
kpis.signal: Continuous improvement driven by portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Share of high credit score loans
kpis.explanation: Proportion of new insured loans with a credit score above 700.
kpis.description: Essent focuses on high-score borrowers, which limits claims.
kpis.signal: Portfolio increasingly higher quality, reducing future risk.

risks.title: Regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict insurance sector regulations, which may impact its business.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which may affect its market share.

risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk from its borrowers, which may impact its solvency.

risks.title: Technology risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology to operate, which may be vulnerable to security breaches.

risks.title: Reputational risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be affected by reputational issues, which may impact its business.

risks.title: Geopolitical risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in an unstable geopolitical environment, which may affect its business.
